en.headline: Police arrest two men after seizing drugs from North Point car
en.dek: Officers found about 43 grammes of suspected cocaine and ketamine in a private car outside Tanner Road on Tuesday night; the passenger tried to flee.
body: Police arrested a 55-year-old man and a 35-year-old man on Tuesday night after finding suspected drugs in a private car in North Point.

Officers received a report around 9pm about two suspicious men in a vehicle parked outside 18 Tanner Road, believed to be taking drugs inside. When police arrived, the 35-year-old passenger tried to run away and was subdued.

A search of the car, with help from a sniffer dog, turned up about 43 grammes of suspected cocaine and ketamine. The 55-year-old driver, surnamed Lui, and the passenger, surnamed Tam, were arrested on suspicion of drug trafficking. Tam is also suspected of obstructing police.
Police said the two men did not know each other and appeared to be conducting a transaction. Both remain detained. The case has been passed to the Eastern district crime investigation team.

zh.headline: 北角私家車檢獲毒品 兩名男子被捕
zh.dek: 警方周二晚上在丹拿道外一輛私家車內檢獲約43克懷疑可卡因及氯胺酮，35歲乘客試圖逃走被制服。
body: 警方周二晚上在北角一輛私家車內檢獲懷疑毒品，拘捕一名55歲及一名35歲男子。
警方於晚上約9時接獲報告，指一輛停泊在丹拿道18號外的私家車內有兩名可疑男子，懷疑在車內吸毒。警員到場時，35歲男乘客企圖逃走，隨即被制服。
在紉毒犬協助下搜查車輛後，發現約43克懷疑可卡因及氯胺酮。55歲司機（姓雷）及35歲乘客（姓譚）涉嫌販毒被捕，其中譚某另涉嫌阻差辦公。
警方稱兩人互不相識，事發時疑正進行交易。兩人現正被扣留，案件交由東區警區刑事調查隊跟進。
